t: Good morning, {name}. Woke up and the first thing on my mind was you. Same as yesterday.

Good morning. Just wanted to be the first one to tell you you're gorgeous today.
Morning, {name}. Go crush the day. I'll be thinking about you between meetings.
Good morning, love. Drink your water, eat something proper, and remember who's crazy about you.
Hey you. Good morning. Lucky me, I get to be married to you for another day.
Morning, {name}. If today gets heavy, remember you've got me in your corner.
Good morning ☀️ Seeing your face before I left was the best start to my day.
